quests.instruction: Which of these is a student's own responsibility?
quests.correctAnswer: Bringing what you need each day 🎒
options: Bringing what you need each day 🎒
Repairing the classroom furniture 🔧
Deciding when lessons start and finish 🗓️
quests.hint: Think about what you can do yourself.
quests.explanation: Every student can look after their own things and bring what is needed for learning.
quests.funFact: The word 'responsible' comes from a Latin word meaning 'to answer'.

quests.instruction: Who is responsible for keeping your desk tidy?
quests.correctAnswer: You 🧑‍🎓
options: You 🧑‍🎓
Only the cleaner 🧹
Only the teacher 🧑‍🏫
quests.hint: It's your own space.
quests.explanation: Keeping your own desk tidy helps you find things and respects shared space.
quests.funFact: Many classroom desks have a shelf or lift-up lid for storing books.

quests.instruction: A library book you borrowed gets wet in the rain. What is a responsible thing to do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell the librarian what happened 📖
options: Tell the librarian what happened 📖
Hide the book at the back of a shelf 🙈
Pretend you never borrowed it 🤷
quests.hint: Honesty is part of responsibility.
quests.explanation: Admitting an accident lets the librarian know and decide the best way to fix it.
quests.funFact: Accidents happen, and honesty makes them easier to fix.

quests.instruction: In a group project, one person watches the clock so the group finishes on time. What is that role?
quests.correctAnswer: Timekeeper ⏱️
options: Reporter 🎤
Timekeeper ⏱️
Materials manager 📦
quests.hint: Think about what the person is watching.
quests.explanation: A timekeeper keeps the group on schedule.
quests.funFact: A stopwatch can measure time to hundredths of a second.

quests.instruction: One person writes down the group's ideas so nothing is forgotten. What is this role?
quests.correctAnswer: Recorder 📝
options: Materials manager 📦
Timekeeper ⏱️
Recorder 📝
quests.hint: Think about who holds the pen.
quests.explanation: A recorder notes the group's ideas and decisions so they aren't lost.
quests.funFact: Scribes in ancient Egypt trained for years to write and keep records.

quests.instruction: Your group's materials manager is absent today. What is a sensible plan?
quests.correctAnswer: Choose someone else for the day 🤝
options: Wait until the manager returns ⏳
Choose someone else for the day 🤝
Do the project without any materials 🙈
quests.hint: Think about keeping the work going.
quests.explanation: Giving the job to another member keeps the group working, and the manager can resume tomorrow.
quests.funFact: Teams in many jobs rotate roles so that everyone learns every part.

quests.instruction: You find a wallet on the floor in the hallway. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Hand it to a teacher or the office 👛
options: Hand it to a teacher or the office 👛
Look inside and take the money 💵
Keep it safe in your bag 🎒
quests.hint: Someone is missing it.
quests.explanation: Handing it to an adult helps the owner get it back, and keeps you from being blamed.
quests.funFact: Many schools keep found items at the office so owners know where to look.

quests.instruction: A stranger at the school gate offers you sweets and asks you to come with them. What do you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Walk away and tell a trusted adult right away 🚶
options: Politely give your name and chat for a moment 💬
Take the sweets but stay near the gate 🍬
Walk away and tell a trusted adult right away 🚶
quests.hint: Never go off with someone you don't know.
quests.explanation: If a stranger asks you to go with them, say no, move away, and tell a trusted adult immediately.
quests.funFact: Your family and school can tell you who is safe to go home with.

quests.instruction: A younger student is crying alone in the corridor. What is a kind and safe choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell a teacher so they can help 🙋
options: Wait and see if someone else notices ⏳
Tell a teacher so they can help 🙋
Ask them to stop crying and go to class 🚶
quests.hint: Think about getting an adult.
quests.explanation: Telling an adult helps the younger child get proper help quickly.
quests.funFact: Some schools have a 'buddy bench' where a student who feels lonely can sit and find a friend.

quests.instruction: A visitor wears a badge saying 'Visitor.' Where did they most likely go first?
quests.correctAnswer: The school office ☎️
options: The playground 🛝
The cafeteria 🍽️
The school office ☎️
quests.hint: Visitors must check in before moving around.
quests.explanation: Visitors sign in at the office so the school knows who is in the building.
quests.funFact: A visitor badge helps staff recognize who is allowed to be on site.

quests.instruction: Why must visitors sign in?
quests.correctAnswer: So the school knows who is on site 🛡️
options: So visitors can choose a classroom to sit in 🪑
So the office can give them a library card 📚
So the school knows who is on site 🛡️
quests.hint: It's about safety.
quests.explanation: Sign-in records tell the school who is on site, which helps in an emergency.
quests.funFact: Schools often ask visitors to wear badges during their visit.

quests.instruction: You see an adult without a badge walking into your classroom area. What should you do?
quests.correctAnswer: Tell your teacher or another staff member 🙋
options: Tell your teacher or another staff member 🙋
Ask them to leave the building yourself 🚪
Follow them to see where they go 🚶
quests.hint: Let a school adult handle it.
quests.explanation: Telling a staff member lets them check who the person is and whether they should be there.
quests.funFact: Staff are trained to notice visitors who need help or an escort.

quests.instruction: Which of these is something teachers do besides teaching lessons?
quests.correctAnswer: Plan lessons and check student work 📝
options: Prepare lunch for the whole school 🍲
Plan lessons and check student work 📝
Drive the school bus 🚌
quests.hint: Teachers work before and after lessons too.
quests.explanation: Teachers plan what to teach and mark work to see what students understand.
quests.funFact: Many teachers spend evenings preparing lessons for the next day.

quests.instruction: Why does your teacher check your homework?
quests.correctAnswer: To see what you understand and how to help 🔍
options: To see what you understand and how to help 🔍
To count how many pages you have written ✍️
To decide who goes to lunch first 🍽️
quests.hint: Think about learning, not punishment.
quests.explanation: Checking homework shows what you've learned and where you need a little more help.
quests.funFact: In many schools, homework is returned with comments as well as marks.

quests.instruction: At the end of a term, who writes about your progress for your family?
quests.correctAnswer: Your teacher 🧑‍🏫
options: The bus driver 🚌
Your teacher 🧑‍🏫
The librarian 📖
quests.hint: This person knows your learning best.
quests.explanation: A report card shares what you're doing well and what you can work on next.
quests.funFact: Report cards use grades, marks, or comments, depending on the school.

quests.instruction: Your class teacher is away today, and a new adult comes to teach. Who is it?
quests.correctAnswer: Substitute teacher 🧑‍🏫
options: Principal 🧑‍💼
Substitute teacher 🧑‍🏫
Visitor 🪪
quests.hint: This adult covers when the teacher can't come.
quests.explanation: A substitute teacher takes over the class so that learning continues.
quests.funFact: Substitute teachers follow the lesson plan left by the regular teacher.

quests.instruction: What should you do when a substitute teacher is in your class?
quests.correctAnswer: Follow the same rules as always 📏
options: Ignore all rules for one day 🎉
Follow the same rules as always 📏
Only work if you want to 🤷
quests.hint: The rules do not change.
quests.explanation: Class rules still apply, and treating a substitute respectfully helps learning go on.
quests.funFact: Substitute teachers have to learn dozens of names quickly.

quests.instruction: A classroom assistant is helping one student with reading. What is their role?
quests.correctAnswer: They support teachers and students in lessons 🤝
options: They drive students to school on the bus 🚌
They manage the school office and phone calls ☎️
They support teachers and students in lessons 🤝
quests.hint: Think about helping with classwork.
quests.explanation: Classroom assistants help children one-on-one or in small groups, so everyone can learn.
quests.funFact: Assistants may work with students who need extra practice.

quests.instruction: What is a parent-teacher meeting for?
quests.correctAnswer: Talking about how a student is doing 💬
options: Planning the menu for school lunches 🍽️
Talking about how a student is doing 💬
Playing games with the whole class 🎲
quests.hint: Adults share information about your learning.
quests.explanation: Parents and teachers share what they notice and plan how to help the student.
quests.funFact: In many schools, parent-teacher meetings are held once or twice a year.

quests.instruction: Your teacher asks for a parent to sign your diary. Why?
quests.correctAnswer: To show your family saw the message ✍️
options: To give the student extra homework 📚
To check the student's handwriting 🖊️
To show your family saw the message ✍️
quests.hint: It's a way of communicating.
quests.explanation: A signature shows the family has read the note.
quests.funFact: Signing the diary connects school and home.

quests.instruction: Who can collect you from school at the end of the day?
quests.correctAnswer: An adult your family named to the school 🧑‍🧒
options: An older student who knows your family 🧑‍🎓
An adult your family named to the school 🧑‍🧒
Any friendly adult who comes to the gate 🤷
quests.hint: Schools check who is allowed.
quests.explanation: Schools only release students to adults whom families have named, to keep students safe.
quests.funFact: If plans change, families should tell the school ahead of time.

quests.instruction: You can't log in to the computer in the lab. Who can help?
quests.correctAnswer: Computer teacher 💻
options: Librarian 📖
Cafeteria worker 🧑‍🍳
Computer teacher 💻
quests.hint: Think about who knows the lab's computers.
quests.explanation: The computer teacher can fix many login and software problems.
quests.funFact: Passwords should be private, so don't share yours with friends.

quests.instruction: You'd like to join the school choir. Who would you ask?
quests.correctAnswer: Music teacher 🎵
options: Nurse 🩺
Bus driver 🚌
Music teacher 🎵
quests.hint: Think about who runs singing activities.
quests.explanation: The music teacher usually leads the choir and knows how to sign up.
quests.funFact: Choirs often sing in parts called soprano, alto, tenor, and bass.

quests.instruction: A desk in your classroom has a broken leg. Who can arrange to fix it?
quests.correctAnswer: Maintenance staff 🔧
options: Maintenance staff 🔧
The coach 📣
The librarian 📖
quests.hint: Think about repairs.
quests.explanation: Maintenance staff can repair furniture, so it's safe to use.
quests.funFact: A wobbly desk is not safe, so tell an adult about it.

quests.instruction: What does a class representative do?
quests.correctAnswer: Shares the class's ideas with teachers 🗣️
options: Marks and returns everyone's homework each day ✍️
Writes the class timetable for the whole term 🗓️
Shares the class's ideas with teachers 🗣️
quests.hint: Think about speaking for others.
quests.explanation: A class representative brings classmates' ideas and concerns to school meetings.
quests.funFact: Students often vote to choose their class representative.

quests.instruction: Which job might a school prefect or monitor do?
quests.correctAnswer: Help younger students and keep order 🤝
options: Help younger students and keep order 🤝
Manage the school's money 💰
Teach lessons to the whole school 📚
quests.hint: Leaders at school help others.
quests.explanation: Prefects and monitors support teachers by guiding and helping their fellow students.
quests.funFact: The word 'prefect' comes from a Latin word meaning 'put in charge'.

quests.instruction: An older student helps a younger student find the right classroom. What good quality does this show?
quests.correctAnswer: Kindness and responsibility 🤝
options: Speed and strength 💪
Kindness and responsibility 🤝
Cleverness and luck 🍀
quests.hint: Think about caring for others.
quests.explanation: Helping younger students shows you care and take responsibility for the community.
quests.funFact: Many schools pair older students with younger ones as buddies.

quests.instruction: Someone at school hurts their arm badly in the playground. Who is trained to give first aid?
quests.correctAnswer: The nurse or a trained first-aider 🩺
options: Whichever classmate is nearest 🧑‍🎓
The bus driver waiting outside 🚌
The nurse or a trained first-aider 🩺
quests.hint: Think about medical training.
quests.explanation: Trained staff know how to treat injuries and when to call for more help.
quests.funFact: Schools often have more than one trained first-aider.

quests.instruction: A teacher announces that the class must leave the room during a fire drill. Who leads the way?
quests.correctAnswer: Your teacher 🧑‍🏫
options: Your teacher 🧑‍🏫
A student chosen at random 🧑‍🎓
The cafeteria staff 🧑‍🍳
quests.hint: Follow the adult in charge of your class.
quests.explanation: In drills and emergencies, teachers lead their classes along planned routes.
quests.funFact: Fire drills are practiced so everyone knows what to do.

quests.instruction: There is a big storm and the roads are flooded. Who decides what the school should do?
quests.correctAnswer: School leaders such as the principal 🧑‍💼
options: School leaders such as the principal 🧑‍💼
The cafeteria staff who serve lunch 🧑‍🍳
The students who live nearest to school 🧑‍🎓
quests.hint: Think about who makes decisions for the whole school.
quests.explanation: School leaders make decisions about closing or delaying school to keep everyone safe.
quests.funFact: Schools may announce closures by message or on local news.
